I make a chicken pasta dish my family looooves... boil up a pkg of penne or ziti, and cut up some chicken into bite-size chunks (I use tenders, because I can get a big package of those for like $6). Saute the chicken in some butter (with a touch of olive oil to keep it from burning) in a skillet; when it's brown and cooked through, deglaze the pan with a little white wine.
